DG press was founded in August 2009 with 12 employees (all former Drent Goebel employees). Initially, the emphasis was primarily on services, such as maintenance and the sale of spare parts.

DG press relocated to the former Drent Goebel office and production hall in 2013. This provided the company with the opportunity to build new machines. Today DG press is a specialist in the engineering, installation, servicing and maintenance specialist of Drent Goebel printing presses (Vision and VSOP®).

DG press has more than 30 years of experience and offers exceptional servicing and support to its global customer base. The company’s mission is to deliver exceptional service and customer commitment. To bind and retain customers, strengthening our market reputation and stimulating our innovative power.
